_comment: FIXTURE v2 sprite-sheet manifest (docs/SPRITE-TRANSITION.md T3) — hand-built to the exact T2-generator output shape, used by build/gen-sprite-registry.py until T2's real generator lands. 2 realms x 2 kinds, 36 cells. Monster-kind cells: 18/20 join to real dev/model-qa/realm-bestiary-draft.json creature names (90%, meets the >=90% gate); 2 monster cells + all 16 npc cells deliberately do NOT join, to exercise the WARN/null path (npc kind is not counted against the monster-kind join-coverage gate).

cells.name: Threshold Rat
cells.cue: Vermin omen fleeing whatever else lives here

cells.name: Guttered Wick
cells.cue: Drifting corpse-light that steals your shadow

cells.name: Grinning Poppet
cells.cue: The haunted doll that creeps when unwatched

cells.name: Pallid Newcomer
cells.cue: Fresh-buried neighbor still walking its route

cells.name: Bone-Rattle Skeleton
cells.cue: Reassembled grave-bones, a cult's patient tool

cells.name: Zealous Initiate
cells.cue: Robed true-believer running the ritual anyway

cells.name: Static Reflection
cells.cue: Mirror-double, one second behind, draining you

cells.name: Rot-Handed Ghoul
cells.cue: Grave-eater whose bite paralyzes the mourner

cells.name: Moonshackled Cur
cells.cue: Half-turned wolf-thing running with the pack

cells.name: Attic Moth Swarm
cells.cue: Fixture-only non-joining cell for the WARN path

cells.name: Gravedigger's Apprentice
cells.cue: Younger, still flinches at what he digs up

cells.name: Night-Shift Deacon
cells.cue: Runs the graveyard-hour rites nobody asked for

cells.name: Widow's Errand-Runner
cells.cue: Fetches for the grieving, keeps their secrets too

cells.name: Streetlamp Keeper
cells.cue: Lights the ones that still work, avoids the ones that don't

cells.name: Tithe Collector
cells.cue: Collects for the church, and for something else

cells.name: Choir Loft Watchman
cells.cue: Listens for the wrong note in the hymn

cells.name: Backroom Fortune-Teller
cells.cue: Reads cards that are usually right, unfortunately

cells.name: Coffin-Fitter's Boy
cells.cue: Measures the living for practice, he says

cells.name: Dust-Broke Drifter
cells.cue: Desperate gun-for-hire, breaks and runs when losing

cells.name: Line-Rider
cells.cue: Fence patrol with a rifle and a grudge

cells.name: Coyote-Thing
cells.cue: Wrong-jointed wolf that runs alone, not in a pack

cells.name: Scarecrow Sentinel
cells.cue: Field-post construct that only moves when watched

cells.name: Claim-Jumper
cells.cue: Scouts a strike then steals the paperwork

cells.name: Company Enforcer
cells.cue: Collects the mine's debts with a bandit's manners

cells.name: Buzzard-Kin
cells.cue: Oversized carrion bird, waits for you to slow down

cells.name: Dust Devil
cells.cue: Sand-and-fire elemental that walks the flats

cells.name: Debt-Collector Ghoul
cells.cue: Undead loan shark, still keeps a ledger

cells.name: Rustbucket Prospector
cells.cue: Fixture-only non-joining cell for the WARN path

cells.name: Trailhead Deputy
cells.cue: Keeps the peace on the road in, mostly

cells.name: Saloon Piano Man
cells.cue: Plays through anything, never looks up

cells.name: Claim Office Clerk
cells.cue: Files the paperwork nobody reads twice

cells.name: Rail Line Foreman
cells.cue: Pushes the crew past what's safe, on schedule

cells.name: Bounty Board Clerk
cells.cue: Posts the notices, takes a cut on the quiet

cells.name: Wagon Train Scout
cells.cue: Reads sign better than anyone left alive

cells.name: Assay Office Weigher
cells.cue: Thumb on the scale, everyone knows, nobody proves it

cells.name: Telegraph Operator
cells.cue: Hears the news first, sells the good parts
